rows.question: 请按仓库列出2026年3月采购收货数量，汇总收货明细的实际件数，不是采购订购量或单据数。
rows.subject: global_analyst

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT "dim_warehouse"."warehouse_name" AS "warehouse_name", SUM("fact_receipt"."quantity") AS "received_units" FROM "fact_receipt" AS "fact_receipt" JOIN "dim_warehouse" AS "dim_warehouse" ON "fact_receipt"."warehouse_id" = "dim_warehouse"."warehouse_id" WHERE "fact_receipt"."receipt_date" >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND "fact_receipt"."receipt_date" < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY "dim_warehouse"."warehouse_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 我权限范围内2026年9月各产品型号期末库存有多少件？每个SKU和仓库分别取当月最新快照，再按型号汇总。
rows.subject: regional_supply

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: WITH "latest_snapshot" AS (SELECT "fid"."sku_id" AS "sku_id", "fid"."warehouse_id" AS "warehouse_id", "fid"."quantity" AS "quantity", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "fid"."sku_id", "fid"."warehouse_id" ORDER BY "fid"."stock_date" DESC) AS "rn" FROM "fact_inventory_day" AS "fid" WHERE "fid"."stock_date" BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)) SELECT "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", SUM("ls"."quantity") AS "total_quantity" FROM "latest_snapshot" AS "ls" JOIN "dim_sku" AS "ds" ON "ls"."sku_id" = "ds"."sku_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "ds"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" WHERE "ls"."rn" = 1 GROUP BY "dp"."product_id" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 2026年7月我权限范围内各故障分类新建多少条工单？同一台设备多张工单分别计数。
rows.subject: regional_service

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT "dim_fault"."fault_name" AS "fault_name", COUNT("fact_service_ticket"."ticket_id") AS "ticket_count" FROM "fact_service_ticket" AS "fact_service_ticket" INNER JOIN "dim_fault" AS "dim_fault" ON "fact_service_ticket"."fault_id" = "dim_fault"."fault_id" WHERE "fact_service_ticket"."created_date" >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND "fact_service_ticket"."created_date" <= CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY "dim_fault"."fault_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 2026年5月我能查看的设备，按产品型号计算设备日离线率，返回型号名称、总设备日样本量和百分数；online=0算离线。
rows.subject: regional_service

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(*) AS "total_device_days", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "fdd"."online" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "offline_rate_percent" FROM "fact_device_day" AS "fdd" JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "fdd"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" WHERE "fdd"."event_date" >= CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) AND "fdd"."event_date" <= CAST('2026-05-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY "dp"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 2026年9月我权限内售出设备按型号计算30天激活率，只纳入观察满30天的设备，未激活和晚激活留在分母，列出设备分母、激活分子和百分数。
rows.subject: regional_service

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: WITH "cohort" AS (SELECT "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", "p"."product_name" AS "product_name", "o"."paid_date" AS "paid_date" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" INNER JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "i" ON "o"."order_id" = "i"."order_id" INNER JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "b" ON "i"."item_id" = "b"."item_id" INNER JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" INNER JOIN "dim_product" AS "p" ON "d"."product_id" = "p"."product_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE)), "activation" AS (SELECT "c"."device_id" AS "device_id", "c"."product_name" AS "product_name", CASE WHEN NOT "a"."activation_date" IS NULL AND "a"."activation_date" >= "c"."paid_date" AND "a"."activation_date" <= "c"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_activated" FROM "cohort" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "fact_device_activation" AS "a" ON "c"."device_id" = "a"."device_id") SELECT "activation"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "activation"."device_id") AS "devices", SUM("activation"."is_activated") AS "matched_devices", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "activation"."device_id") = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM("activation"."is_activated") * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "activation"."device_id"), 2) END AS "rate_percent" FROM "activation" AS "activation" GROUP BY "activation"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 按产品型号看2026年9月我权限内售出设备的30天售后设备率。只取成熟队列，含退款设备；多次报修按一台设备计，列出设备分母、售后分子、百分数。
rows.subject: regional_service

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: WITH "sold_devices" AS (SELECT "d"."product_id" AS "product_id", "p"."product_name" AS "product_name", "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", MIN("o"."paid_date") AS "paid_date" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "oi" ON "o"."order_id" = "oi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "b" ON "oi"."item_id" = "b"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "p" ON "d"."product_id" = "p"."product_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE) AND "o"."status" = '已支付' GROUP BY "d"."product_id", "p"."product_name", "b"."device_id"), "service_devices" AS (SELECT "d"."product_id" AS "product_id", "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", MIN("o"."paid_date") AS "paid_date" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "oi" ON "o"."order_id" = "oi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "b" ON "oi"."item_id" = "b"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE) AND "o"."status" = '已支付' GROUP BY "d"."product_id", "b"."device_id") SELECT "sd"."product_id" AS "product_id", "sd"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id") AS "devices", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "st"."device_id" IS NULL THEN "sd"."device_id" END) AS "matched_devices", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id") = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "st"."device_id" IS NULL THEN "sd"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id"), 2) END AS "rate_percent" FROM "sold_devices" AS "sd" LEFT JOIN "fact_service_ticket" AS "st" ON "sd"."device_id" = "st"."device_id" AND "st"."created_date" >= "sd"."paid_date" AND "st"."created_date" <= "sd"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY GROUP BY "sd"."product_id", "sd"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 请按渠道名称统计2026年7月我权限范围内的净销售额，退款扣回原支付月份，不是按退款发生月份记账。
rows.subject: regional_sales

assessment.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset match raw-row Python oracle

rows.sql: SELECT "c"."channel_name" AS "渠道名称", SUM("oi"."amount" - COALESCE("r"."refund_amount", 0)) AS "净销售额" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "c" ON "o"."channel_id" = "c"."channel_id" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "oi" ON "o"."order_id" = "oi"."order_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "refund_amount" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "r" ON "oi"."item_id" = "r"."item_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."status" = '已支付' GROUP BY "c"."channel_name" LIMIT 1001
